description: Adds the FedRAMP Moderate baseline and CMMC Level 2 to the core profile, scoped to the SaaS platform boundary. Used to size the authorization effort before committing to a date.

excluded_controls.PE-02: no removable media permitted within the authorization boundary; enforced by platform policy

notes: Enterprise status data is reused here deliberately. Control inheritance from the underlying cloud service provider is NOT modelled; inherited controls would materially change this picture and are the first thing a real authorization effort would separate out.
